name: suede-newsroom
description: Suede-owned editorial pipeline for agent-run content: six roles with written contracts, one inspectable record that travels between them, and a distribution stage that gives every asset its own argument instead of a shorter draft. Use when content agents return generic, duplicated, or unsourced work, when repurposed posts all sound like the same post, when one flagship piece has to carry a week of distribution, or when someone asks to build an AI content team, an editorial pipeline, or a one-per
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一套面向 AI 内容团队的编辑流水线，用明确分工和可追溯记录减少空泛、重复和无来源内容，并将主稿转化为各具观点的分发素材。
